SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', Birthday) > 55
AND PT >= 14
